implemented_phases: exercise, OOD, runtime, and Longstaff-Schwartz evidence
measured runtime scaling against project CRR and optional QuantLib engines
operational crossover and lifecycle break-even analysis
business workload scenarios and Research Question 7 answer
strict final export, manifest hashing, and end-to-end readiness validation

upstream_notebooks.06: specialist exercise classifier and joint price-decision model
upstream_notebooks.08: balanced scratch benchmark and warm-start integrated deployment model

final_conclusion_policy.small_or_one_off_valuation: project CRR, finite difference, or QuantLib
final_conclusion_policy.repeated_static_price_only: Notebook 05 constrained residual model inside the validated domain
final_conclusion_policy.repeated_price_and_exercise: Notebook 08 warm-start integrated model inside the validated domain

hypothesis_rules.H1: Direct MLP common-test MAE / Black-Scholes proxy MAE <= 0.95
hypothesis_rules.H2: Notebook 05 validation-selected residual MAE / Direct MLP MAE <= 0.98
hypothesis_rules.H3: Selected constrained model has zero lower-bound violations while Direct MLP has positive violations
hypothesis_rules.H4: Notebook 06 multi-task model must be classification-noninferior and improve boundary pricing under its predefined thresholds; Notebook 08 is supporting evidence
hypothesis_rules.H5: Selected static neural model seconds per option / high-resolution CRR seconds per option <= 0.50
hypothesis_rules.H6: Every eligible static neural pricing model has aggregate OOD/in-domain MAE ratio >= 1.25

separation_rules: Static pricing and exercise decisions are evaluated on the aligned 187811-row common test set
Longstaff-Schwartz methods remain on their separate contract-level held-out experiment
Static inference, numerical valuation, path-based valuation, simulation, and training are separate runtime families
H5 uses the selected static pricer against CRR; neural LSM runtime is secondary evidence
H6 is decided across all eligible static neural pricing models, not one preferred model
Cold-start and warm-service runtime are reported separately
Measured and extrapolated runtime rows are labelled explicitly
Operational crossover excludes sunk training cost; lifecycle break-even includes it
Missing historical build times produce explicit scenarios rather than invented point estimates
Notebook 05 and Notebook 08 are compared according to their different output scopes

research_question_7_policy.question: When does neural inference provide a meaningful practical speed advantage over numerical valuation?
evidence_levels: operational crossover for one valuation job
lifecycle break-even after label generation and training
research_question_7_policy.selection_constraint: speed claims are conditional on accepted in-domain accuracy and numerical fallback outside the training domain
